answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond of 500 POA, tied to one identity vertex in the reputation graph. Trust grows only through completed jobs, each adding a signed edge to that vertex. A sybil attacker chasing 1,000 fake identities must lock 500,000 POA up front and staff every fake with real work, while any detected fraud burns the bond outright. The bond works like a shopfront deposit: cheap for one honest trader, ruinous at fake scale. The violet badge on a long-lived vertex marks earned history, and newcomers gather at that trusted oasis instead of trusting each stranger.
